identity.author: Mark M. Wilde
identity.title: From Classical to Quantum Shannon Theory
identity.edition_note: Cambridge University Press second-edition prepublication draft; DOI 10.1017/9781316809976
identity.arxiv_comment: 774 pages, 301 exercises, 81 figures; second edition prepublication draft

source_archive.use: Used to inspect original TeX where PDF text extraction rendered a covering-lemma radical ambiguously.

extraction.format: born-digital PDF text extraction; no OCR
extraction.quality: All 774 PDF pages are represented in the extraction. Mathematical symbols are substantially extractable; source TeX was checked for the covering lemma's error term, confirming epsilon + 4 sqrt(epsilon) + 24 epsilon^(1/4).
limitations: A few roots, superscripts, and tensor labels are linearly reordered by PDF text extraction; formulas used in findings were checked in the PDF and, when necessary, original TeX.

The full bibliography and index are saved in extracted text but were not read cover-to-cover; pages 747-750 were inspected while identifying sources. All substantive chapters and both substantive appendices were read.
